# stratusphere/scripts/ops/New-SandboxStratusphere.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Deploys or plans the Stratusphere UX Hub with deadline auto-shutdown/auto-teardown and automatic VNet peering to a standalone Windows 11 test VM.

Wraps Deploy-Stratusphere.ps1 with ephemeral lab/sandbox defaults: - Names the resource group rg-<Name>-<Environment>-stratusphere (default: rg-ssux-dev-stratusphere) so Invoke-AvdSandboxDeadline in avdlz-runs-rg matches rg-<Name>-<Environment>-*. - Arms two OneTime schedules in aa-avdlz-runs before deploying any billable resource: G1 (Deallocate) at +ShutdownAfterMinutes (default 120 minutes) G2 (Delete) at +TeardownAfterMinutes (default 240 minutes) - Stamps avdlz-component, avdlz-owner, avdlz-purpose, avdlz-shutdown-utc, avdlz-teardown-utc, avdlz-shutdown-schedule, and avdlz-teardown-schedule tags on the resource group and resources. - Attaches a daily 20:00 Central Standard Time Microsoft.DevTestLab/schedules shutdown task (shutdown-computevm-vm-<Name>-hub) as belt-and-suspenders protection. - Automatically discovers a standalone test VM VNet matching rg-<TestVmName>-<Environment>-vm / vnet-<TestVmName>-vm (or any rg-*-<Environment>-vm in the subscription when -TestVmName is omitted), adopts its region when -Location is not explicitly passed, and peers vnet-<Name>-stratusphere ((address in the source)) with it both ways.
